entities.summary: Vivienne Yeda Apopo is a Kenyan banker and business attorney. She is the Director General of East African Development Bank (EADB). A position she was appointed to on the 15 January 2009. Since March 14, 2011, she has also serves as a member of the board of directors of the Central Bank of Kenya.
